-- Phase 09: server-side historical usage aggregation for the Customer Analytics view.
-- Forward-only, additive, and scoped to a user ID supplied only by the trusted FastAPI boundary.

create or replace function public.moreai_customer_usage_analytics(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_since timestamptz,
  p_until timestamptz
)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $function$
  with scoped as (
    select
      model_key,
      provider_key,
      status,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      coalesce(actual_cost, estimated_cost, 0) as cost,
      latency_ms,
      created_at
    from public.llm_usage
    where user_id = p_user_id
      and created_at >= p_since
      and created_at < p_until
  ),
  summary as (
    select
      count(*)::bigint as total_requests,
      coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0)::bigint as total_tokens,
      count(*) filter (where status in ('succeeded', 'completed'))::bigint as successful_requests,
      count(*) filter (where status in ('failed', 'error'))::bigint as failed_requests,
      coalesce(sum(cost), 0)::numeric as total_cost,
      coalesce(round(avg(latency_ms) filter (where latency_ms is not null)), 0)::bigint as average_latency_ms
    from scoped
  ),
  model_rows as (
    select
      model_key,
      provider_key,
      count(*)::bigint as requests,
      coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0)::bigint as tokens,
      count(*) filter (where status in ('succeeded', 'completed'))::bigint as successful_requests,
      coalesce(sum(cost), 0)::numeric as cost
    from scoped
    group by model_key, provider_key
  ),
  day_rows as (
    select
      date_trunc('day', created_at) as day,
      count(*)::bigint as requests,
      coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0)::bigint as tokens,
      coalesce(sum(cost), 0)::numeric as cost
    from scoped
    group by date_trunc('day', created_at)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'summary', (select to_jsonb(summary) from summary),
    'by_model', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(model_rows) order by requests desc, model_key asc)
      from model_rows
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'by_day', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'day', day::date,
          'requests', requests,
          'tokens', tokens,
          'cost', cost
        ) order by day asc
      )
      from day_rows
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'period', jsonb_build_object('since', p_since, 'until', p_until)
  );
$function$;

revoke all on function public.moreai_customer_usage_analytics(uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz) from public;
revoke all on function public.moreai_customer_usage_analytics(uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz) from anon;
revoke all on function public.moreai_customer_usage_analytics(uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz) from authenticated;
grant execute on function public.moreai_customer_usage_analytics(uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz) to service_role;

create or replace function public.moreai_customer_workspaces_page(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_limit integer default 50,
  p_cursor_updated_at timestamptz default null,
  p_cursor_id uuid default null
)
returns table (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  slug text,
  owner_user_id uuid,
  status text,
  created_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz
)
language plpgsql
stable
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $function$
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 100);
begin
  if p_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'customer_user_id_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if (p_cursor_updated_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception 'pagination_cursor_invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  return query
  with accessible_workspace_ids as (
    select w.id
    from public.workspaces as w
    where w.owner_user_id = p_user_id
      and w.status = 'active'
    union
    select w.id
    from public.workspace_members as wm
    join public.workspaces as w on w.id = wm.workspace_id
    where wm.user_id = p_user_id
      and wm.status = 'active'
      and w.status = 'active'
  )
  select w.id, w.name, w.slug, w.owner_user_id, w.status, w.created_at, w.updated_at
  from public.workspaces as w
  join accessible_workspace_ids as accessible on accessible.id = w.id
  where p_cursor_updated_at is null
     or (w.updated_at, w.id) < (p_cursor_updated_at, p_cursor_id)
  order by w.updated_at desc, w.id desc
  limit (v_limit + 1);
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.moreai_customer_workspaces_page(uuid, integer, timestamptz, uuid) from public;
revoke all on function public.moreai_customer_workspaces_page(uuid, integer, timestamptz, uuid) from anon;
revoke all on function public.moreai_customer_workspaces_page(uuid, integer, timestamptz, uuid) from authenticated;
grant execute on function public.moreai_customer_workspaces_page(uuid, integer, timestamptz, uuid) to service_role;
